description: Complete read/dump conversations against factory_fresh SimulatedMicroFreak. Case 1 (slot 200, reply_lag off): name read + reply, then the dump. Case 2 (slot 511, reply_lag ON — dumps are unaffected by name-reply lag): dump only. A dump is: open [bank,pos,0x01] (unanswered), then strict lockstep — 146 pull-next 0x18 requests (len 0x01, payload [0x00]), each answered by one chunk (145 x 0x16 + 1 x 0x17, 32 bytes each) echoing its pull's seq. Session seqs walk 1..127 and wrap SKIPPING 0 (the addressed-request counter never emits 0). Reassembled blob must be exactly 4672 bytes. All byte sequences are uppercase two-digit hex, space-separated ('F0 00 20 6B ...'). Regenerate: python3 tools/gen_vectors.py (from the repo root).
